mentions.name: LLM Text Rephraser
mentions.description: This is a small LLM-based tool that rephrases text, with attention to preserving the original meaning and the requested tone when rewriting.
mentions.problem: Model output often looks correct while subtly changing meaning or missing the requested tone, which turned out to be a bigger challenge than generation itself.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building a small LLM-based text rephrase tool, but it turned into something different than I expected.

evidence.value: I’m building a small LLM-based text rephrase tool, but it turned into something different than I expected.
